cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Let Them Keep Hope
cards.instruction: Hide discouraging information because you believe hope is the only thing keeping someone able to continue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Keep the seed packets. We're on the allotment waiting list. Open the tomato packet carefully, please; we can start these on my windowsill.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You're covering our number. If it's another year indoors, I'm giving up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The number doesn't affect germination. Please separate those seeds; three in each pot, not a handful. I'll deal with the letter.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You'll want your windowsill back before we get a plot.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Use my sunny bedroom. I'll move the bed. Keep the trays level when you carry them in, please; we haven't done all this to tip them out now.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1/A3 teach seed handling while hiding queue position; A5 supplies durable space and corrects transport to prevent B giving up.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 exposes the covered number; B4 doubts temporary hospitality, directly causing A5's larger room offer.

relationship.evidence: B4 raises a practical long-term concern rather than just refusing hope.

heightening.evidence: A5 commits personal space in response to B4, developing protection from words into sacrifice.
